action.alignment: recorded command at same row; not future measured state
action.validity: action_validity plus temporal padding; unobserved slots masked

tactile.mosaic_layout: 2 rows x 5 columns; left hand top, right hand bottom; thumb to pinky left to right
tactile.orientation: preserve source sensor image axes, no mirroring or rotation
tactile.normalization: Fixed video-range grayscale conversion and divide by 255; black=0, increasing intensity=stronger SDK deformation response
tactile.physical_interpretation: Relative contact-deformation intensity; not calibrated pressure, force or indentation depth
tactile.availability: All ten fingertips installed by source definition; decoded zero remains valid zero contact; undecoded frame invalid
tactile.temporal_alignment: Source video PTS and original per-episode from_timestamp; exact 30 Hz grid; no forward interpolation
tactile.composition: exactly one map per canonical region

deduplication.ftp1_sharpa: excluded from FTP-1 release and mixture

splits.policy: preserve published native train/val episode identity

publication.new_work: External ten-fingertip deformation cache; no such cache exists in the prepared native dataset
